item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan gar dbang rang gling pa'am ye shes g.yung drung bstan pa'i nyi mas chu sprel cho 'phrul zla ba'i yar tshes 1”las (la) dbal bon ru lag shel ri phyug mo'i g.yas phyogs brag ri zla gam 'dra ba'i phug chu srin gre ba nas spyan drangs pa la spa rigs bla ma g.yung drung bstan pa 'brug grags gtsos bla grwa mang pos nan bskul mdzad cing / nye bar sprul pa'i gter chen bde chen gling pa'i rgyal sras brgyud 'dzin pad+ma phrin las dpal bzang po sras yum rnams nas rab dkar lha rdzas bcas bskul bzhin chu bya sa ga zla ba'i yar tshes bcom ldan thub pa'i dbang po sku 'khrungs pa'i sangs rgyas dus ston chen mo'i skabs su shog ser bod yig tu bsgyar nas zhal bshus te drung yig tshul khrims blo ldan dang yi ge dang po'i 'du byed tshul grags nas bgyis pas gsang chen bstan pa kun tu rgyas pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
